mappingRules.status: Reviewed by collaborator, 11 November 2026; saved reviewed values reconciled for implementation.

scale.0: No justified inference / unknown, not a negative score

wellSpecified.1: Normal desirable capability: weight 1, counted once if actually present and usable
wellSpecified.Bundle: Resolve contents and count unique usable capabilities; a confirmed usable unresolved bundle may contribute one fallback benefit, never plus its constituents
wellSpecified.2: Especially desirable capability: weight 2, counted once after capability deduplication
wellSpecified.3: Exceptional or unicorn capability: suggested weight 3, counted once after capability deduplication

mappingRules.hiddenPreference: Always active at importance100 (More important), participates in the same weighted preference-fit calculation; does not add visible controls or count as a user-completed input.
mappingRules.integration: Apply option evidence inside each selected visible preference, using its existing importance; do not create a second independent sport/luxury bonus. Keep essentials, points caps and points-usage ranking unchanged.
mappingRules.normalisation: Monotonic bounded weighted-total-to-score calibration still needs implementation. More desirable distinct capabilities or a higher reviewed weight must never lower the hidden score. Use one common scale across the eligible candidate set.
mappingRules.deduplication: Benefit groups flag minimum overlap, not a complete bill of materials. Resolve model-specific pack contents and tiers before counting. Use highest tier per capability. Separate functions such as seat heating and ventilation can each count once. Visible preference evidence also uses the strongest signal once per underlying capability: package plus roll-up markers never stack, and each dimension stays bounded.
mappingRules.leadLabel: The primary description is a lead source label, not a universal label. Resolve descriptionVariants by model/trim before matching or displaying equipment. Source-reported optionType and normalized review category are separate fields.
mappingRules.evidenceBoundary: Observed option dictionary availability does not prove a feature is fitted. Registered selection proves selected configuration, not VIN verification. Only selected/fitted and active usable features may affect a vehicle score. Unknowns get no invented evidence.
mappingRules.tradeoffs: Reviewed values override original proposed inferences, including sporty paint, practical storage/size and charging-card fuel evidence. Model body/powertrain facts remain authoritative for gates.
mappingRules.baseline: Baseline compliance/safety/admin, colour-only choices and preparatory/deletion codes are excluded. Premium aesthetics/materials have explicit subjective mappings for review.

wellSpecifiedWeights.numericRule: Numeric desirability weights must be between 0 and 3 inclusive. 11 is an input typo interpreted as 1. 0 excludes, 1 normal, 2 highly desirable, 3 exceptional/unicorn.
wellSpecifiedWeights.meaning: Sum desirability weights after deduplicating underlying capabilities; this replaces a raw option count.
wellSpecifiedWeights.overlap: For duplicate codes or tiers describing the same capability, take the highest applicable reviewed weight once. Never sum a package weight and the same included components.
wellSpecifiedWeights.importance: Keep the hidden preference importance fixed at100 (More important). Option desirability weight and preference importance are different controls.
